messages.text: Ember produced routes for all 42 vans this morning. Two drivers overrode their routes because of a street market in Alfama.
Driver feedback sessions move to Thursdays at 16:00 so the night shift can join.
Van 17 broke down at 10:00. Ember re-solved the remaining stops for the other vans in 40 seconds.
After three weeks, fuel cost per stop is down 4 percent. Early, but promising.
Drivers asked for a way to flag loading docks with long waits so the solver can avoid them at peak times.
